preserved_from_v1_2: The exact Zaporizhzhia user pin is 47.83206 N, 35.13137 E.
G1/007 Love remains a fixed project coordinate gate with its existing ICRS target vector.
The Corben + Leeloo multipass payload identity is unchanged by changing the terrestrial observer.
The route layer is a project/model construction and does not assert a literal physical transmission.
correction_notice.corrected_in_v1_3: A fixed Love ICRS coordinate does NOT imply that the derived EDEM upstream direction is observer-independent. The executed reciprocal geometry explicitly derives a different EDEM direction from each observer frame, and the Giza-to-Zaporizhzhia change moves the derived candidate by 62.198154 degrees. Therefore EDEM must remain observer-anchored and unconfirmed until an observer-independent gate exists.

observer_frame_comparison.scientific_meaning: The current reciprocal construction does not define a stable observer-independent celestial EDEM point. Moving the terrestrial observer from Giza to Zaporizhzhia changes the derived direction by tens of degrees, far larger than the frozen primary tolerance.
observer_frame_comparison.admission_effect: EDEM_SEARCH_CENTER_ZP may be used as a search-center candidate for catalog/coverage probes, but not as confirmed coordinates of Eden/Edem.

love_gate.important_distinction: Love is fixed in ICRS, but the derived reciprocal EDEM direction is generated by local observer geometry and is therefore not fixed merely because Love is fixed.

horizon_firewall.trigger: In the Zaporizhzhia best solution, Love altitude is only 0.000127114444 degrees, effectively a horizon-boundary case.

canonical_status_ru: Корректировка принята: Запорожье даёт EDEM_SEARCH_CENTER_ZP = RA 139.2240968659°, Dec +30.2603877995°, но это только observer-anchored направление-кандидат. Его лучший январский геометрический момент 2026-01-05 02:03:34 UTC на южной грани имеет ошибку 12.8408° при frozen gate 0.25°, поэтому gate FAIL.
